title: Do river and lake FEATURE populations wave during play? E5 forced them for 20,000 ticks and drew none, yet every river/lake save holds feature-ref units spawned at embark (platypus on RIVER3; stingray, alligators, hippos on LAKE). Natural play, no manipulation, a full year on RIVER3 and a season on LAKE, plus a LAKE season with the surface deliberately held shut so only a feature gate could open.
fork: F5 reopened: feature entries spawn at embark; do they wave again, on what gate, and what do they do on the map

predictions.model: feature entries wave in play on their own gate/timer
predictions.expects: arm natural: at least one arrival with feature_idx >= 0 in a year on RIVER3; feature entries debited

predictions.model: feature entries spawn only at embark (or map load)
predictions.expects: no feature-ref arrival in any arm; the embark units age out and are never replaced

predictions.model: feature waves share the surface gate
predictions.expects: arm surface_held (surface units kept held): no feature arrival; arm natural: feature arrivals only in gaps between surface groups

kill_criterion: one feature-ref arrival during play settles existence; its timing against the surface hold decides the gate
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
